title: One Hall, Seven Master Crafts | Guangzhou Heritage Day P2 | China Travel Expert
description:
One ancestral hall in Guangzhou carries seven different master crafts — all on its walls and roofs.

The Chen Clan Ancestral Hall (Chen Clan Academy) was built 1888–1894, funded by Chen families across Guangdong. Across its 15,000㎡ and nineteen buildings it gathers the “Seven Wonders” of Lingnan decorative art: wood, stone and brick carving; ceramic and lime sculpture; iron casting; and painting. It’s widely called “the pearl of Lingnan architecture.” This is Stop 2 on my Guangzhou Heritage Day walking route — after Guangxiao Temple (P1), next comes the Qilou arcades (P3).

🧭 Expert Tip: Come around 4pm — low afternoon sun rakes across the roof ridges and lights up the ceramic figures.
